intent.outcome: brew outdated (formula+cask) runs lazily when Outdated is first selected (or Status needs it), coalesces concurrent callers, and respects a configurable TTL (default 30m) so navigation/refresh does not stampede Homebrew.

problem.description: Init and RefreshMsg always fetch Outdated with every panel. Cache TTL is a single 30s on the client. Concurrent Status dashboard + panel fetch can double-call before cache fills. No singleflight; no outdated-specific TTL; not lazy.

in_scope: Lazy load: do not call Formulae.Outdated/Casks.Outdated on Init unless Outdated (or Status dashboard path that needs counts) is active — pick one policy and document: preferred = skip on Init; Status uses cache or lightweight path.
Request coalescing (singleflight) for outdated formula and cask fetches inside brew layer or GUI fetch.
Configurable TTL: e.g. brew.outdated_ttl or cache.outdated_ttl duration (default 30m); wire into cache Get/Set or dedicated stale check.
RefreshMsg should not force outdated re-fetch if within TTL unless user is on Outdated panel and presses R (document behavior).
Unit tests: coalescing (1 brew call for 2 concurrent), lazy (0 calls before panel select), TTL config parse default.
out_of_scope: Combining formula+cask into one brew outdated invocation (optional later).

acceptance_criteria.description: Two concurrent outdated list requests produce a single in-flight brew outdated invocation (coalesced).
Init (default config) does not invoke brew outdated until Outdated panel is selected (or documented Status exception).
Outdated TTL is configurable in YAML config with default 30m; documented field name in Default().
Within TTL, a second Outdated fetch returns cached data without a new brew process.

design_decisions.choice: Singleflight at brew reader Outdated methods (shared in-flight per key)
design_decisions.rationale: GUI and Status both call the same readers; coalescing below GUI covers all callers.

design_decisions.choice: Skip outdated on Init fetch batch; fetch on first switchPanel(Outdated) or explicit Refresh while on Outdated
design_decisions.rationale: Matches AC-02. Status dashboard may show stale/empty outdated counts until first Outdated visit or use last cache — document in step.

steps.action: Add config field for outdated TTL default 30m; parse duration; wire cache or reader stale check.
Singleflight coalesce concurrent Outdated calls on formulae and casks readers.
Remove Outdated from Init eager batch; fetch on first Outdated panel select (and document Status interaction).
Tests for coalesce, lazy, TTL hit; full gui+brew green.
